name: Expense & Mileage Log
tagline: Keep job expenses and kilometres on your phone, then download a CSV.
audience: Sole proprietors and small businesses that track spending and driving
before: Receipts live in a glove box and kilometres live in a notes app. At tax time you retype both.
after: Log an expense or a trip in a few fields. The list stays on this phone or computer, and you can download a CSV for your bookkeeper.
privacy_note: Entries stay in this browser. Clearing the browser's site data deletes them. Nothing is sent to us.
built_with: One web page. The CSV is built in the browser.
